$comment: Phase-1 scope for the traceability gate (tools/traceability/check.mjs). Every rule ID of GAME_RULES.md not listed under outOfScope needs a tagged assertion; every entry needs a reason; an entry for an unknown ID fails the gate.

R-BOARD-003.reason: Tech squares are not part of classic-v1 and are off for the Phase 1 playtest (GAME_RULES section 2.1); positions and categories are open (A-02). Revisit with the first layout that has tech squares.

R-MODE-BLITZ-001.reason: Blitz is not in Phase 1 (E-1.5 is Classic vs bot); needs the clock actions TIMEOUT and `at`, reserved in engineRulesVersion 1.

R-MODE-ARENA-001.reason: Arena mode is a later epic (Phase 2+); the engine has no HP model in engineRulesVersion 1.

R-MODE-ARENA-002.reason: Arena effects are a later epic (Phase 2+); depends on A-06 and on season config.

R-MODE-DAILY-001.reason: Daily challenges are a later epic (Phase 2+); the generator and the server-side one-submission rule do not exist yet.

R-MODE-KNOWLEDGE-001.reason: Knowledge challenges are untestable as written (A-08) and a later epic.

R-POW-001.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5); tests are written with E-3.2.

R-POW-002.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5); kill switches arrive with the powers.

R-POW-AIASSIST.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5).

R-POW-CACHE.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5).

R-POW-COMPILE.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5).

R-POW-CONTAINER.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5); also ambiguous (A-09).

R-POW-DEBUG.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5); also breaks conservation as written (A-09).

R-POW-REFACTOR.reason: Powers are out of scope for Phase 1 (GAME_RULES section 8, E-1.5).

R-CORE-002.reason: Asserted: (a) no client-supplied field (score, validity, timer, power) is read by apply. Not asserted: (b) offline vs-bot results carry `competitive: false` and ingestion rejects them; that is a progression/rating contract (Phase 2), the engine state has no such flag.

R-MODE-CLASSIC-001.reason: Asserted: (a) 1v1, 2v2 and FFA 3/4 configs. Not asserted: (b) live clock and (c) 24 h correspondence deadline need clock actions (reserved, Phase 2); expiry behaviour is A-03.

R-MODE-CLASSIC-002.reason: Asserted: (a) no clock fields, (b) powers rejected, (d) replay without delays gives the same hash. Not asserted: (c) `competitive: false` is a progression/rating ingestion contract (Phase 2); the engine state has no such flag.
